benchmarks.gate: full-loss-stressed PASS expectancy must beat zero and the in-scope Pump control
benchmarks.honest_prior: negative; demonstrated sellers and speed may reduce rugs but do not imply alpha
benchmarks.metric: closed-PASS paper bankroll, UNEXITABLE_TIMEOUT rate, and expectancy net of toll with unavailable exits at full loss
benchmarks.null: same paper execution on a deterministic sample of in-scope Pump.fun coins rejected by another screen rule

kill_switch.rule: HALT if, after n>=N_min terminal PASS trades, stressed mean_R + 1.645*SE < 0.
